text:
sec-bot: SECURITY ADVISORY: parsing vuln in libproxy-httpx v3.8.0 (high). Affects Dedicated + Private images built before 2024-07-01. Immediate actions required.

marta: Short checklist?

sec-bot: 1) Rebuild runtime images using libproxy-httpx >=3.8.1 and publish patched tags. 2) Rotate any long-lived connector/service-account keys issued before 2024-07-01. 3) Deploy temporary header-normalization WAF at edge. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/runbooks/libhttpx (internal)

ashley: I'll start rolling runtime rebuilds and orchestrate cluster updates. Rolling strategy: maxUnavailable=1 per region. Use rollout status to monitor.

ops-bot: Scheduling connector rotation job: rotate-175500 for us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Start window: 2024-04-05T02:00Z. Will report per-region completion.

oliver: Hosted API unaffected (managed fleet already patched). Focusing inventory on Dedicated clusters and customer private images. Quick detection: `kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}' | grep libproxy-httpx`

marta: Ops, prioritize connectors that talk to customer VPCs/on-prem. Legal/CS: prepare advisory draft but hold public send until >=80% clusters patched or on visible customer impact.

ops-bot: Update: us-west-2 connector rotation completed, old keys revoked. Remaining regions: ap-southeast-1.

ashley: us-west-2 runtime rollout completed, smoke tests green. Proceeding to next region.

sec-bot: If you see header-parse errors or spikes, tag logs with `libhttpx-incident` and escalate to #incidents. Example grep: `journalctl -u inference | grep -i "header parse"`

marta: Thanks team. Postmortem owner: marta. Will assemble timeline after we reach stable state.

ops-bot: Final status at 1755003034: 100% affected Dedicated clusters patched, connector rotations complete. Moving to monitoring.
